question.problem: Use a calculator to evaluate ${log}_{11}⁡(7)$ rounded to $3$ decimal places.

current_example.problem: Use a calculator to evaluate $\log_3 (7)$ rounded to $2$ decimal places.
current_example.worked_solution:
Let's calculate $\log_3 (7)$ by changing the base $3$ to the common logarithm (base $10$).

We use the change of base formula:

$$
\log_a X = \dfrac {\log_b X} {\log_b a}
$$

In our case, we have $a=3,$ $X =7,$ and $b=10.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{log}_{3}⁡(7) & =\frac{{log}_{10}⁡(7)}{{log}_{10}⁡(3)} \\  & =\frac{\operatorname{log}⁡(7)}{\operatorname{log}⁡(3)} \\  & ≈\frac{0.845\,10}{0.477\,12} \\  & ≈1.77.\end{aligned}
$$
